# KhunShawn (Rashaan Arrington)
> KhunShawn is the YouTube name of Rashaan Arrington: a gaming and reaction creator, digital nomad, event filmmaker, author and speaker. This site is his hub: the numbers, the events, the books, and how brands work with him. Brand name for the content team behind it: Khun Camp.

## Who he is
- Main channel: KhunShawn (https://www.youtube.com/@KhunShawn). Daily reaction videos on gacha games, gaming and VTuber breakdowns.
- Second channel: KhunVlogs (https://www.youtube.com/@StillKhunShawn). Travel, festivals and interviews from Southeast Asia.
- Author of three Kindle books, $2.99 each, under the name Rashaan Arrington. Author page: https://www.amazon.com/stores/Rashaan-Arrington/author/B0GTC3CNVD
  - Energy Chimera: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GTHDDW26
  - Broadcast Yourself: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GT5XJQHH
  - Innerstanding: A Way Of Life: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HKGH3NF7
- Speaker. Talk at Nomads in Paradise 2026: "Augmenting Yourself: Building AI Systems Around Your Gift" (Oct 19, 2026, Siargao).
- Public name to use: KhunShawn (Rashaan Arrington).

## How brands work with him
- Integrated ads inside videos and YouTube Live streams. Pricing on request.
- First-look reactions: KhunShawn reacts on camera to a game, trailer or product as he sees it for the first time. Pricing on request.
- Event coverage: films, interviews and clips for festivals and conferences. Pricing on request.
- Speaking. The host covers flights and hotel. Fee on request.
- Inquiries: https://khuncamp.com/brands#inquire or Shawn@getkhuncamp.com. Replies within one business day.

## Events
- Nomads in Paradise 2026, Siargao, Philippines, Oct 16 to 25, 2026: on-site media team, daily recaps, five films and speaker interviews. https://khuncamp.com/siargao
- Da Nang Nomad Fest, Vietnam: videography and interviews. https://khuncamp.com/events#da-nang
